author: claude
description: Every request fetches tenant settings from the config service, which is now our largest source of p99 latency and of load on that service. This adds a per-instance in-memory cache to `SettingsService` with a 30 second TTL. Concurrent misses for the same tenant share one in-flight fetch, and `update()` drops the entry so the instance that made a change sees it right away; other instances converge within the TTL, which is acceptable for settings. Tests cover hit/miss counting, expiry, and read-after-update.

defects.mechanism: The cache hands every caller the same TenantSettings object, but buildContext in request-context.ts mutates it in place to apply per-request overrides (x-locale, staff feature previews). Once cached, one user's language choice or a staff member's preview features leak into every other request for that tenant until the entry expires.

The promise is cached before it settles and is never evicted on rejection, so a single transient config-service error (timeout, 503) is replayed to every request for that tenant for the full 30 second TTL instead of being retried.
